scopeReview: CED FUN-3.A.1: derivatives of x^r by definition or direct power rule, with applicable real domains. No product/quotient/chain rules assessed. Endpoint and negative-input fractional powers use explicit real-root interpretations.
varietyReview: Four derivative-formula tasks are complemented by a point value, unknown exponent, direct derivative at zero, a positive-input slope equation, a slope ratio, error diagnosis and fractional-power domain analysis. Numeric differences corroborate exact power/root arguments rather than prove identities from samples.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
